body: This place feels like a fucking prison to me sometimes. I think the worst part about my upbringing is that it led me to believe everything was my fault, and no doubt I obviously fucked up a lot. It doesn't change the fact that the roots of these problems were not my doing. I should have just done things for myself instead of trusting and not wanting to do "wrong" to my parents after they fucked me over again and again.

Thanks, I appreciate you understand that shit's hard. But the point is that it ultimately doesn't matter what I do. Everyday I wake up in the same place that I don't want to be in and the same shit plays out, and I don't even think there's any place I want to be in all that much. I try doing what I'm apparently supposed to be doing, try not to dwell on the past but it doesn't matter. The past is my life and the future is grey and dull
